module_summary: Bridges the native PicoRV32 valid/ready memory bus to AXI4-lite by combinationally driving AW/W/AR channels from mem_valid/mem_wstrb, with per-channel ack flags and a transfer-done flag.

anchors.name: mem_valid
anchors.why: Native bus request; gates all AXI valid/ready outputs and clears ack flags when low.

anchors.name: mem_ready
anchors.why: Native bus completion, formed from AXI bvalid or rvalid.

anchors.name: mem_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI write-address valid, asserted for write requests until acknowledged.

anchors.name: mem_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read-address valid, asserted for read requests until acknowledged.

anchors.name: mem_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: AXI write-data valid, asserted for writes until the W beat is accepted.

anchors.name: mem_wstrb
anchors.why: Byte strobes; nonzero selects write channels, zero selects read channels.

anchors.name: ack_awvalid
anchors.why: Per-channel accepted flag; suppresses AW valid after handshake (representative of ack flags).

anchors.name: xfer_done
anchors.why: Registered completion of a native transfer; clears all channel ack flags.

anchors.name: mem_addr
anchors.why: Native address forwarded to both awaddr and araddr.

anchors.name: mem_wdata
anchors.why: Native write data forwarded to AXI wdata.

anchors.name: mem_rdata
anchors.why: Read data returned to the core, copied from AXI rdata.

anchors.name: mem_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: AXI read response valid; produces mem_ready for reads.

anchors.name: mem_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: AXI write response valid; produces mem_ready for writes.

anchors.name: mem_instr
anchors.why: Instruction-fetch flag; sets arprot to instruction access.

groups.name: AXI channel handshake control
groups.description: Ack flags and done flag sequence AW, W, AR valids per native request.

groups.name: Native-to-AXI bridge
groups.description: Forwards address, write data, strobes, protection, read data and responses between buses.
